name: cookie-banner-example
description: Demo service showing how to implement GOV.UK Design System cookie banner with Google Tag Manager in Hapi.js

scripts.dev: vite build --mode development && npm-run-all2 --parallel frontend:watch server:watch
scripts.dev:debug: vite build --mode development && npm-run-all2 --parallel frontend:watch server:debug
scripts.test: npm run build:frontend && cross-env TZ=UTC vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:frontend && cross-env TZ=UTC vitest run --coverage --project unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:frontend && cross-env TZ=UTC vitest run --coverage --project integration

author: Defra DDTS
